workouts.description:
A) Find the number of Unbroken reps that will challenge you but let you perform 4 repetitive sets with no problem. 
This number must be 1-3 reps higher than your usual comfortable unbroken set during a metcon.

12/10 Cal Ski
5 High Box Jump Overs
1 set of unbroken HSPU
